mechanism.claim: When one Binance BTC spot stablecoin-quote book uniquely leads the next-minute common return of the other books, price discovery is concentrated rather than simultaneous noise. During elevated BTC variation, follow the concentrated leader only when its final-two-hour direction agrees with the common eight-hour displacement.
mechanism.side: strict common sign of the leader book final-two-hour return and the three-book median eight-hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: Stablecoin-flow candidates use taker imbalance, participation, or sequential flow. Dominant-quote disagreement uses contemporaneous return disagreement. Spot/perpetual error-correction uses a two-venue basis. HVQPLR uses only lagged predictive price leadership among three spot quote books and no prior event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed BTCUSDT eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed daily cross-quote predictive-leadership clocks are absent from Gross9

features.window: exact 480 completed one-minute bars [D-8h,D) at D in 00:00/08:00/16:00 UTC
features.return: log(close_t/close_t-1) on each exact grid; first return uses the exact D-8h-1m close
features.book_target: for book j, median of the other two books' contemporaneous one-minute returns
features.predictor: book j return lagged exactly one minute
features.lead_score: max((SSE intercept-only - SSE intercept+slope)/SSE intercept-only,0) over the 479 aligned observations; nonpositive denominator or nonfinite fit invalid
features.lead_share: unique largest lead_score divided by sum of all three positive lead_scores; strict >=0.60; ties invalid
features.direction_confirmation: leader final 120-minute log return and median of all three eight-hour log returns have the same strict nonzero sign
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared BTCUSDT one-minute log returns across the exact completed eight-hour window)
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier fixed-boundary valid states, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: D after all source bars through D-1m complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.published_basis: price-discovery leadership is measured with lagged predictive contribution; this exact BTC adaptation is unpublished

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no book, window, regression, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
